newsitem.title: GERMANY: German Postbank sets up DAX investment fund.
newsitem.headline: German Postbank sets up DAX investment fund.

text.p: Germany's postal savings bank Postbank AG said on Thursday it would set up a fund to invest in the 30 stocks of Frankfurt's DAX index.
The fund, with a minimum investment of 5,000 marks and a fee of 2.5 percent, is aimed at a broad base of investors "who seek an above-average return".
The fund will be managed by Deutsche Postbank Asset Management S.A., a subsidiary of Deutsche Postbank International S.A. Luxembourg.
The initial subscription period ends March 14.
Postbank said it manages 106,000 accounts totalling 1.7 billion marks.
